done_when: When Codex still reports an active writer after the one retry, a cold read starts a new Codex conversation and prints one plain line saying why, and a work round refuses with a line that says another program holds the conversation and how to free it.
why: A cold read fails with 'Codex never reported the turn's end' when another program, such as the Codex desktop app, still holds its earlier Codex conversation open, and a work round in the same case gives the same misleading line.
